opennyai_summary.final__ANALYSIS:

Ltd. and her criminal history has been explained in paragraph nos. 26 and 27 of the affidavit filed in support of the present bail application and all the offences are triable by Magistrate-I Class and applicant is in jail since 26.12.2017 in the present case i.e. for last more than five years, therefore, considering the long incarceration of the applicant, in my view applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
